title: Anima vs. Heidi: AI medical scribes for GP practices
summary: Anima Scribe vs. Heidi for GP practices: compare AI consultation notes, clinical coding, templates and EHR integration, with FAQs on choosing a medical scribe.
body_markdown:
## What is an AI medical scribe?


An AI medical scribe turns consultation speech into draft clinical documentation for a clinician to review. Ambient transcription gives clinicians more room to listen while preparing a record of the conversation. The draft needs to capture the clinical detail, be easy to review and reach the patient record without unnecessary copying.


Anima Scribe, Heidi, Accurx Scribe and TORTUS turn consultation speech into draft notes. The detail matters: what the note captures, how easily you can correct it and how it reaches the patient record. Here’s how Anima Scribe and Heidi compare.


## Comparing Anima and Heidi


Anima Scribe and Heidi both support clinical documentation. Follow a consultation through recording, draft notes, clinical coding and saving to the patient record. Heidi's current documentation describes an EMIS integration through Hero Health. Confirm the integration and plan available to your organisation rather than assuming the same setup applies to every clinical system.

## FAQs


### What makes an AI scribe useful in general practice?


Use representative consultation scenarios in a demonstration, including more than one problem, changes of topic and an unclear audio passage. Compare the draft with what was actually said. Check how easily the clinician can correct omissions, remove irrelevant detail and distinguish symptoms reported by the patient from the clinician's assessment. The clinician still needs to review the documentation before saving it.


### What should you check about EMIS Web and SystmOne integration?


Ask each supplier to demonstrate the complete save-to-record workflow in your clinical system. Establish whether the connection transfers free text, structured sections, clinical codes or observations, and whether it requires another product or subscription. Check the handling of patient identity and the steps needed to correct a note after saving.


### How should you compare medical scribe pricing and deployment?


Evaluate the plan your practice would buy, including templates, coding, integration, team administration and support. Ask about recording retention, access controls and the information patients receive before the tool is used. For a practice-wide rollout, involve clinicians and your information governance lead, and measure review time alongside documentation time.
